answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the marble of a task receipt, and the ember is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the zephyr of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
